ibisworld_business_environment_profile_u.description: Runs when IBISWorld updates an economic indicator's profile, such as consumer spending or a commodity price.

output.collection: The report's collection, such as COR (core).
output.country: The report's country code, such as US.
output.last_modified_date: When its content last changed (UTC); empty where IBISWorld gives none.
output.published_date: When IBISWorld last published it (UTC, ISO 8601).
output.title: The report's title.

parameters.description: The country whose profiles to watch: US, CA, AU, NZ, UK or DE.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: Only these profiles: codes separated by commas, such as I302. Leave empty for every profile.

parameters.description: Only BED (business environment profiles) or PPI (producer price indexes). Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The reports' language: English, German or French. Defaults to English.

ibisworld_industry_report_updated_trigge.description: Runs when IBISWorld publishes or refreshes an industry report in a country your licence covers.

output.collection: The report's collection, such as COR (core).
output.country: The report's country code, such as US.
output.last_modified_date: When its content last changed (UTC); empty where IBISWorld gives none.
output.published_date: When IBISWorld last published it (UTC, ISO 8601).
output.title: The report's title.

parameters.description: The country whose reports to watch, such as US.

parameters.description: Only these industries: IBISWorld codes separated by commas, such as 11111, 23822a. Leave empty for every industry.

parameters.name: collection

parameters.name: language

ibisworld_risk_rating_changed_trigger.description: Runs when the overall risk score or level of an industry you watch changes. Checked hourly.

output.country: The country code, such as US.
output.direction: up, down or unchanged (when only the level changed).
output.overall_level: Overall risk now in words, such as Medium - High.
output.previous_overall_level: The overall risk level before the change.
output.previous_overall_score: The overall risk score before the change.
output.published_date: When the risk report was last published (UTC).
output.score_change: The new score less the previous one.
output.title: The industry's title.

parameters.description: The industries' country: US, CA, AU, NZ, UK or DE.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: The industries to watch: up to 25 IBISWorld codes separated by commas, such as 11111, 23822a.
parameters.name: industries

parameters.description: The reports' language: English, German or French. Defaults to English.
parameters.name: language

ibisworld_risk_report_published_trigger.description: Runs when IBISWorld publishes an industry's risk report, which it does monthly.

output.collection: The report's collection, such as COR (core).

output.last_modified_date: When its content last changed (UTC); empty where IBISWorld gives none.
output.published_date: When IBISWorld last published it (UTC, ISO 8601).
output.title: The report's title.

parameters.description: The country whose risk reports to watch: US, CA, AU, NZ, UK or DE.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: Only these industries: IBISWorld codes separated by commas. Leave empty for every industry, which can be hundreds of runs a month.
parameters.name: industries

parameters.description: The reports' language: English, German or French. Defaults to English.
